parts.text:
Fig. 8.1 is a transmission electron micrograph of striated muscle.
{{figure:figure_8_1.webp}}
Fig. 8.1
On Fig. 8.1:
- use the letter P with a label line to show a region containing only actin
- use the letter Q with a label line to show a region containing only myosin
- use the letter R with a label line to show a region containing both actin and myosin.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Striated muscle contraction is explained by the sliding filament model.
Outline the role of the proteins troponin and tropomyosin in the sliding filament model.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Striated muscles can sometimes become less efficient at contracting if they have been active for a long time. This is called muscle fatigue.
Suggest why muscles may become fatigued.
